full_text:
The Elder Guardian of Thor is one of the Guardians of Thor who guards the secrets of the Temple of Thor. 

== History ==
The Elder and the other Guardians who used the Incantation of Asgard to invoke Ymir and sent him after the Huntik team. The Elder welcomed them into the Temple of Thor after they crossed the Rainbow Bridge. [The Legacy of Thor] Under the influence of the Organization, and the Unnamed Suit 012 as his new "master", he tried to protect the magical hammer, Mjolnir, from the Huntik Foundation team but failed. [Two Powers Become One]

== Abilities ==
The Elder Guardian of Thor wielded a sword in battle and, like the other guardians, used an electrical spell called Thundercut as their primary, if not only, spell. Together they were also able to invoke Ymir through an arcane incantation.
=== Spells Utilized ===

*Thundercut
